requirements.text: 8+ years of technology experience supporting capital markets, derivatives, or structured products platforms.
Strong hands-on Java development experience and proficiency with the Spring Framework.
Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems and real-time front-office trading platforms.
Strong understanding of Equity Derivatives and Structured Notes, including pricing concepts, Greeks and risk measures, lifecycle events, and secondary market dynamics.
Understanding of market-making and trade execution workflows.
Experience working directly with Traders, Structurers, and front-office business stakeholders.
Demonstrated ownership of complex production systems, including reliability, production support, and ongoing improvement.
Experience making architectural decisions and defining development standards.
Proven ability to lead complex initiatives, set technical direction, guide development teams, and mentor engineers.
Experience modernizing platforms through automation, architectural simplification, and technical debt reduction.
Strong knowledge of software design patterns, automated testing, and full lifecycle delivery practices.
Ability to deliver in fast-paced environments where requirements and solutions may initially be unclear.
Strong communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
Direct experience with Structured Notes secondary market platforms.
Experience integrating front-office systems with Operations, Risk, and external vendors.
Additional development experience with Python or C#.
Experience delivering large-scale modernization initiatives within a global financial services organization.
Ability to connect technical decisions to trading needs, operational performance, and business growth.
Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving change across teams.
